from datetime import datetime, timezone

# Parse the datetime string
dt = datetime.strptime('2026-09-02 12:15:00', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')

# As UTC
dt_utc = dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
posix_utc = int(dt_utc.timestamp())

# As local time
posix_local = int(dt.timestamp())

import time
local_tz = time.strftime('%Z')

print(f'Datetime:          2026-09-02 12:15:00')
print(f'POSIX (UTC):       {posix_utc}')
print(f'POSIX (local/{local_tz}): {posix_local}')
"
